points.description: States FALSE (the statement is not correct).
Justification: writing can be done only on fd[1] (the write end) of the pipe.
Justification: reading can be done only from fd[0] (the read end) of the pipe, so write on fd[0] / read on fd[1] is not possible.

rubric.notes: Full marks need FALSE plus a justification that precisely states write only on fd[1] and read only on fd[0]. If the justification is missing or wrong, give 0 overall, as the question says. Part marks only if one direction is stated correctly and the other is not contradicted; swapping the roles of fd[0] and fd[1] earns nothing for that point.
